children: Aerkomm Inc. reported results for the quarter ended Q2 2026, recognizing initial product revenue of $28.5K from satellite tracking box sales and narrowing its net loss to $(2.43M) versus a $(5.01M) loss in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: $28.5K for Q2 2026, compared with $0 in the year-ago quarter.
Net income: Net loss of $(2.43M) for Q2 2026, improved from a net loss of $(5.01M) in Q2 2025 (loss narrowed by $2.58M, (51.5%) YoY).
Diluted EPS: Not reported for the quarter and therefore omitted.
Revenue trajectory: Recognized initial commercial revenue from satellite tracking boxes, signaling early-stage product sales.
Channel and market shift: Transitioning from DCS to FMS pathways and engaging defense primes in Japan, Taiwan and the EU for integrations.
Brand and partnerships: Appointed as OneWeb distributor in Japan and Taiwan and signed a Master Services agreement with a global U.S. SATCOM provider.
Operational milestones: Completed Aerkomm Taiwan merger with Ejectt and secured a regional satellite spectrum permit for Taiwan in 2023.
Product and technology: Advancing multi-orbit terminals, software-defined modems, and OTH radar and EW/ESM solutions targeting unmanned and aviation platforms.
